𝐀𝐅𝐓𝐄𝐑 𝟏𝟔 𝐃𝐀𝐘𝐒 𝐎𝐅 𝐋𝐄𝐈𝐒𝐔𝐑𝐄 𝐈𝐍 🇻🇳🇹🇭🇲🇾🇸🇬, 𝐖𝐄’𝐑𝐄 𝐁𝐀𝐂𝐊!

We just got home after a long and much-needed 𝟏𝟔-𝐝𝐚𝐲 𝐯𝐚𝐜𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 and here’s a last sneak peek from our 𝐓𝐡𝐚𝐢𝐥𝐚𝐧𝐝 🇹🇭 trip! ✨ Our honest take? Thailand is basically 𝐌𝐞𝐭𝐫𝐨 𝐌𝐚𝐧𝐢𝐥𝐚 𝐏𝐫𝐨 𝐌𝐚𝐱, full of traffic, packed streets, and city heat… BUT, you can’t ignore how rich it is in culture, temples, food, and creative spaces 🎨⛩️ We got to experience local food spots, fashion areas, and even visit iconic temples that made it all worth it 🤍

That said, our 𝐭𝐨𝐩 𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐝𝐢𝐜𝐭 𝐬𝐭𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐠𝐨𝐞𝐬 𝐭𝐨 𝐏𝐡𝐮 𝐐𝐮𝐨𝐜, 𝐕𝐢𝐞𝐭𝐧𝐚𝐦 🇻🇳 ✨ It’s giving ✨less crowd✨, super aesthetic views, beautiful landscapes, and most of all, 𝘪𝘵’𝘴 𝘴𝘰 𝘤𝘭𝘦𝘢𝘯 𝘢𝘯𝘥 𝘤𝘩𝘪𝘭𝘭! 🌴 If you're looking for a relaxing spot to unwind, Phu Quoc will forever be a fave!

Now that we’re finally home, 𝐰𝐞’𝐫𝐞 𝐟𝐮𝐥𝐥𝐲 𝐎𝐏𝐄𝐍 for 𝐫𝐮𝐬𝐡 and 𝐧𝐨𝐧-𝐫𝐮𝐬𝐡 𝐭𝐚𝐬𝐤𝐬! 📩 Whether it’s research, write-ups, design, or urgent commissions, just send us a message and we’ll get back to work 💬

Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 1 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Tropical Depression CRISING
Issued at: 5:00 PM, 17 July 2025(Thursday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Metro Manila, Zambales, Quezon, Bataan, Cavite, Bulacan, Pampanga, Laguna, Rizal, Batangas, Nueva Ecija and Tarlac.
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: Possible FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 8:00 PM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.
